blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: For better or worse, LLMs are by now used routinely for scientific writing. 1 1 1 This paper is no exception; we did use AI to assist with writing some of the sections (see Acknowledgments). Many have noticed that recent models fill papers with unnecessary antithesis, stating over and over what the work does not do, in ways that do not contribute to its precision or quality of expression and annoy reviewers rather than impressing them . We study the construction rather than in ACL papers from 2019, ACL-style arXiv papers from 2026, and papers written by GPT models from the same titles and abstracts. Its rate in 2026 is seven times the 2019 rate, and higher still in the GPT papers. Two annotators, blind to the source, find almost no 2019 use annoying and about one in ten 2026 uses; they seldom agree on which, yet about half of 2026 papers contain a use that annoys each of them. Annoying uses present the rejected alternative less favorably than legitimate uses. Raters of preference data and open reward models favor the construction, and an instruction to be honest promotes it. We conjecture that it is a side effect of post-training on pairwise preferences, which credit a disavowal in a single response and cannot register its cost across a text.
blocks.zh: 不论好坏,法学硕士现在都经常用于科学写作。 1,1,本文也不例外;我们的确利用AI协助撰写了部分章节(见Acnowledgements). 许多人注意到, 近期的模型填充不必要的反面文章, 我们研究的不是2019年的ACL论文,2026年的ACL风格arXiv论文,以及GPT模型从同名和摘要中撰写的论文. 它在2026年的收视率是2019年收视率的7倍,在GPT论文中仍然较高. 两位无从得知消息源的注解员发现几乎没有2019年使用过令人烦恼,大约每2026年使用过一款;他们很少就2026年论文中约有一半包含的用法达成一致,然而却令他们各自感到烦恼. 禁用用途与合法用途相比,被否决的替代用途更为不利。 偏好数据的评分者和开放的奖励模式都有利于构建,并且指导诚实地促进构建. 我们猜想,这是对双向偏好进行后培训的副作用,这种偏好在单一反应中都得到否认,无法在案文中记录成本。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models are increasingly part of the production process for scientific text, and their use is leaving measurable traces in academic writing, from the frequency of stylistic vocabulary to lexical choice and sentiment ( Kobak et al., 2025 ; Geng and Trotta, 2025 ; Tudino and Qin, 2024 ; Mak and Walasek, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型日益成为科学文本的制作过程的一部分,其使用正在学术著作中留下可测量的痕迹,从文体词汇的频率到词汇的选择和感情(Kobak等,2025;Geng和Trotta,2025;Tudino和Qin,2024;Mak和Walasek,2025).

blocks.en: One recent pattern is the repeated use of contrastive or corrective formulations that define a claim partly by stating what it is not . The website AI tells ( Druck et al., 2026 ) 2 2 2 https://graphite.io/five-percent/research/ai-tells calls this tendency definition by contrast and reports that recent LLMs produce such corrective framing, including constructions of the form X rather than Y , more than before. At the same time, the authors and some of their colleagues have noticed being annoyed by seeing the construction in the NLP papers they were reviewing in the last ARR cycle; some reviews called it out explicitly and complained that it is a sign of a degraded quality of the papers. Program chairs of NLP venues now discuss “AI-trope-ridden” writing in submissions, and submissions generated wholesale ( Durrett et al., 2026 ) , and readers outside research name contrastive constructions, rather than among them, as marks of LLM writing that they find annoying ( Wikipedia contributors, 2026 ) . Gonzales (2026) furthermore discusses possible information processing-related harms associated with overusing negation constructions.
blocks.zh: 最近的一种模式是,重复使用对比性或纠正性的措辞,其中部分地通过说明索赔不属于什么来界定索赔。 网站AI告诉(Druck等,2026) 2 2 2 https://graphite.io/ five-percent/research/ai-tells. 与此相对照,人们称这一趋势的定义,并报告说,最近的有限责任公司比以前更能产生这种纠正性框架,包括X表而不是Y表的构造。 与此同时,提交人和一些同事注意到,他们看到在他们上一个ARR周期审查的NLP文件中的构思,感到不快;一些评论明确提出,并抱怨说,这是文件质量下降的迹象。 NLP网站的节目主持人现在讨论“AI-trope-rip-ript”的写作,提交书产生了批发(Durrett等人,2026年),以及研究名称对比性构思以外的读者,而不是其中的读者,作为LLM写作的痕迹,他们觉得这令人烦恼(维基百科撰稿人,2026年). Gonzales(2026年)进一步讨论了与过度使用否定建筑相关的信息处理可能带来的伤害。

blocks.en: Rather than is an ordinary English construction with established use for expressing alternatives and preferences ( Thompson, 1972 ; Silvennoinen, 2023 ) . Beyond how often LLMs use rather than and its kin, the question is how this increased use came about, why it can be annoying , and how it affects the readers and their perception of the construction itself, the scientific prose and ultimately, their trust in the field.
blocks.zh: 而不是一种通常的英语建筑,在表达替代品和偏好方面已有既定用途(Thompson, 1972; Silvennoinen, 2023)。 除了LLMs经常使用而不是使用其亲属之外,问题在于这种增加的使用是如何发生的,为什么它会令人烦恼,以及它如何影响读者和他们对建筑本身的看法,科学的传播,并最终影响他们对这个领域的信任。

blocks.en: Answering all of these questions should be a subject of a larger study involving psychologists as well as specialists privy to the details of post-training of commercial systems such as Claude and GPT. Here, we attempt to address some of the preliminaries, in four questions. Q1 : Has rather than become more frequent in NLP papers, and do some 3 3 3 We hypothesize from the start that this will be true only with respect to some commercial models due to the specific post-training they may be using. LLMs use it more often than human authors? Q2 : Do readers find some of its uses annoying , and how likely is a reader to meet an annoying use in a paper? Q3 : What distinguishes annoying uses from legitimate ones? Q4 : Where does the construction come from: does the preference data used in post-training reward it?
blocks.zh: 回答所有这些问题应当成为一项更广泛的研究的主题,其中涉及心理学家和专家,了解诸如克洛德和GPT等商业系统培训后的详细情况。 在这里,我们试图从四个方面来讨论一些初步问题。 问题1:在NLP的论文中, 已经不是更频繁了, 并且做了大约3 3 3 我们从一开始就假设, 仅对某些商业模型来说, LLMS比人类作者更经常使用它? 问题2:读者是否发现其某些用途令人讨厌? 问题3:什么是烦人用途与合法用途的区别? 问题4:构建来自何方:培训后使用的偏好数据是否给予奖励?.

blocks.en: We compare ACL papers from 2019, before widespread LLM-assisted writing, with ACL-style papers from 2026 and with papers written by LLMs from the titles and abstracts of 2019 and 2026 papers. On a sample of occurrences, we separate prevalence from acceptability: two of the authors, both experienced NLP researchers who routinely review for *ACL conferences, blindly labeled each use as legitimate or annoying , 4 4 4 Legitimate is not a neutral opposite of annoying ; Section 4.3 discusses what the label names imply. and we then examine what distinguishes the two classes, including the evaluative stance toward the contrasted alternatives and whether the rejected alternative is a straw man. Finally, we ask where the construction may come from, by examining the preference data used to post-train open models. In brief, the construction has become far more frequent in NLP papers, and more so in papers written by LLMs (Q1, Section 5.1 ); annotators find almost only 2026 uses annoying , and about half of 2026 papers contain a use that annoys a given annotator (Q2, Section 5.2 ); annoying uses disparage the rejected alternative more, and are more often judged to reject a straw man (Q3, Section 5.3 ); and raters of preference data and open reward models reward the construction, which an instruction to be honest also promotes (Q4, Section 5.4 ). We conjecture that it is a side effect of post-training on pairwise preferences, like the known preferences for length and formatting ( Singhal et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and that correcting the phrase alone would move the same function into another form (Section 6 ). Code and data are available. 5 5 5 github.com/olzama/rather-than-public
blocks.zh: 我们比较了2019年的ACL论文,在广泛的LLM辅助写作之前,与2026年的ACL风格论文以及由LLMs从2019年和2026年论文的标题和摘要中撰写的论文. 两位作者都是经验丰富的NLP研究人员, 经常为*ACL会议检讨, 然后我们再研究两个阶层的区别, 包括对对比的替代品的评价立场, 以及被拒绝的替代品是否是一个稻草人。 最后,我们通过审查培训后开放模型所用的偏好数据,询问建造工作可能来自何处。 简而言之,NLP论文的构建更加频繁,而LLMs(Q1, 第5.1节)所撰写的论文的构建更为频繁;注释者发现几乎只有2026种使用烦恼,大约2026种论文中有一半包含一种使用,使给定的注释者感到烦恼(Q2, 第5.2节);令人烦恼的用途更贬低被否决的替代方法,并更经常地被判定拒绝一名稻草人(Q3, 第5.3节);以及优惠数据和开放奖励模型的评级者奖励构建,诚实的指示也促进了这种使用(Q4, 第5.4节)。 我们推测,这是对成对偏好进行后培训的副作用,如对长度和格式的已知偏好(Singhal等,2024;Zhang等,2025),而单是纠正这一短语就会将同一功能移入另一种形式(第6节). 有代码和数据。 5 5 github.com/olzama/相对公用

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 LLM-associated change in academic writing
blocks.zh: 2.1 LLM与学术著作有关的改变

blocks.en: A growing literature tracks the linguistic footprint of LLM assistance in naturally occurring academic text. Kobak et al. (2025) analyze more than 15 million PubMed abstracts and identify a sharp 2023–2024 increase in hundreds of style-related words, using excess vocabulary to estimate a substantial lower bound on LLM-processed abstracts. In arXiv data, Geng and Trotta (2025) show that frequencies of some previously identified ChatGPT-associated words later decline while others continue to rise, arguing that human editing and adaptation make simple lexical detection increasingly unstable. These studies demonstrate that LLM-associated stylistic change can become visible at corpus scale without assigning authorship to individual papers.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的文献在自然形成的学术文本中跟踪LLM协助的语言足迹. 克巴克等编. (2025年)分析超过1500万"普布梅德摘要",并识别出数百个与风格相關的词条急剧地增加了2023–2024个,用多余的词汇来估计LLM处理后摘要上相当低的束缚. 在arXiv的数据中,Geng和Trotta(2025年)显示,一些先前确定的ChatGPT相关词的频率后来会下降而另一些则会继续上升,认为人类的编辑和适应使得简单的词典检测越来越不稳定. 这些研究显示,与LLM相关的结构变化可以从体格上看出来,而不把著作权分配给个人论文。

blocks.en: Other work compares generated and human-authored academic prose directly. Tudino and Qin (2024) report overuse of infrequent academic vocabulary, greater formulaicity, and reduced syntactic and semantic variation in ChatGPT-generated social-science texts. Mak and Walasek (2025) , analyzing 4,820 student empirical reports from 2016–2025, find post-ChatGPT shifts in lexical style and formality as well as a more positive overall sentiment; GPT rewrites of pre-ChatGPT reports reproduce several of these changes.
blocks.zh: 其他作品则直接比较出产和由人作作者的学术散文. 图地诺和秦(2024年)报告过度使用不常用的学术词汇,公式化程度较大,并减少了ChatGPT所生成的社会科学文本中的合成和语义变化. Mak and Walasek (2025年),分析2016–2025年的4,820个学生实证报告,发现后ChatGPT在词汇风格和形式上的转变以及更积极的整体感觉;GPT重写了ChatGPT前期报告转载了其中的几个变化.

blocks.en: 2.2 Contrastive constructions
blocks.zh: 2.2 矛盾建筑

blocks.en: The linguistic literature provides good reason not to treat every occurrence of an antithesis marker as stylistically suspect. Thompson (1972) describes distinctive syntactic and semantic properties of rather than and instead of clauses, while more recent constructional work shows that negated restrictives such as not only , not just , not simply , and not merely participate in several contrastive schemas with different formal and functional profiles ( Silvennoinen, 2023 ) . This motivates our construction-level analysis: a useful contrast and a gratuitous corrective may share a lexical trigger while differing in their effect.
blocks.zh: 语言学文献提供了很好的理由,不把每起反神论标记的发生都当作有型疑似. Thompson(1972年)描述的是条款而非条款的显著的同义和语义性质,而较近期的建构工作显示,否定了限制,如不仅、而且不只是单纯的,而且不只是参与与不同形式和功能特征不同的若干对比性计划(Silvennoinen,2023年)。 这激励了我们的建筑层面分析:一个有用的对比和无谓的纠正可能具有一种法理触发因素,但效果不同。

blocks.en: The closest prior evidence for the specific LLM tendency studied here is Druck et al. (2026) , a large-scale industry study that compares 10,000 pre-ChatGPT human web articles with 90,000 articles generated on matched topics by nine recent LLMs. Using 9,984 topically aligned human/LLM article sets for its main n-gram analyses, that work finds thousands of model-specific lexical and phrasal “tells” and identifies definition by contrast as a recurrent theme. It measures a broader category of corrective framing , including constructions such as rather than , not just , not simply , and does not . For example, GPT-6 Astra’s aggregate corrective-framing rate is reported at roughly 12 times the human rate.
blocks.zh: 这里研究的具体LLM趋势最接近的前证据是Druck等人(2026年),这是一份大规模工业研究,该研究比较了1万篇ChatGPT前人文网络文章和9万篇近期由9个LLMs就相匹配主题生成的文章. 利用9,984个专题对齐的人类/LLM文章集进行其主要正克分析,该工作发现上千个特有模型的词典和用词"tells",并相对地将定义确定为一个反复出现的主题. 它衡量范围更广的纠正性框架,包括诸如而不是仅仅,而不是仅仅,而不是......的构造。 例如,GPT-6 Astra的整流校正分量率大约是人类的12倍。

blocks.en: 2.3 Preference optimization and style
blocks.zh: 2.3 优惠优化和样式

blocks.en: Instruction-tuned models are post-trained on preferences: pairs of responses to the same prompt, one marked as chosen by a human rater or an LLM judge, which are used to train a reward model ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) or to optimize the model directly ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) . Open preference datasets differ in who judges: UltraFeedback ( Cui et al., 2024 ) and the Tülu 3 mixture ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) use GPT-4-class judges, HelpSteer2 and HelpSteer3 ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ) human raters. The aspects the judges rate, such as helpfulness and “honesty”, go back to the aims of the “helpful, honest and harmless” assistant ( Askell et al., 2021 ) . Preference optimization can amplify superficial features that raters reward: responses grow longer, since longer responses are preferred, and much of the measured gain from preference optimization is attributable to length ( Singhal et al., 2024 ) . A reward model is a proxy, and optimizing against it eventually lowers the quality it was meant to measure ( Gao et al., 2023 ) ; Skalse et al. (2022) show that over the full space of policies, a proxy can never be raised without risk to the true reward unless one of the two is trivial, and Casper et al. (2023) survey the resulting limitations of learning from human feedback. In practice, exploited features are identified and corrected one at a time. Length is the best studied, with corrections in the preference objective ( Park et al., 2024 ) and in the reward model ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Raters and reward models also favor lists, bold text, links and emojis ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and responses that match the user’s views ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) . We ask whether a discourse construction is another such feature and whether preferring “honesty” could paradoxically give rise to straw men.
blocks.zh: 指令调取的模型在偏好上是经过后训练的:对同一种即时反应的对接,一个由人评分员或LLM裁判员所选择,用来训练奖励模型(Ouyang等,2022年)或直接优化模型(Rafailov等,2023年). 开放偏好数据集由谁判断: UltraFeedback(Cui等,2024年)和Tülu 3混合物(Lambert等,2025年)使用GPT-4级裁判,HelpSteer2和HelpSteer3(Wang等,2025年a; Wang等,2025b) 人测分. 法官评分的方面,如帮助和“友善”,回到“帮助、诚实和无害”助理的目标(Askell等,2021年)。 优惠优化可以扩大评分者奖励的表面特征:答复增加的时间更长,因为比较长的答复增加的时间更长,而且优惠优化的大部分衡量收益可归因于长度(Singhal等人,2024年)。 一个奖励模式是一个代名词,与之相抗衡的优化最终会降低它原本要衡量的质量(Gao等,2023年;Skalse等(2022年))显示,在政策的全部空间上,除非两者之一微不足道,否则一个代名词永远无法在不冒风险的情况下提升到真正的报酬上,而卡斯珀等(2023年)则调查由此带来的从人类反馈中学习的局限性. 在实践中,被利用的特征一次确定并纠正一次。 长度是研究得最好的,对偏好目标(Park等,2024年)和奖励模式(Chen等,2024年)进行校正. Raters和奖励模型也喜欢列表,粗体文本,链接和emojis(张等,2025年),以及符合用户观点的回复(Sharma等,2024年). 我们问,讨论是否是另一个这样的特征,偏爱“温柔”是否会引起稻草人。

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: We use three datasets: ACL Anthology papers from 2019 (ACL 2019), before LLM-assisted writing was common; ACL-style arXiv papers from 2026 (arXiv 2026); and papers generated by GPT models from the titles and abstracts of 2019 and 2026 papers (GPT; Section 4.2 ). We expect many arXiv 2026 papers to have been written with substantial LLM assistance, given how widely LLMs are now used in academic writing ( Kobak et al., 2025 ) , but we cannot know how much of any given paper an LLM wrote. The GPT papers are written by LLMs by construction, and the ACL 2019 papers predate widespread LLM-assisted writing. Preliminary runs with open and Claude models complement the GPT papers (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个数据集:ACL 2019年的人类学论文(ACL 2019),在LLM辅助写作之前是常见的;2026年的ACL风格arXiv论文(arXiv 2026)和由GPT模型从2019年和2026年论文标题和摘要(GPT; 第4.2节)中生成的论文. 我们期望许多 arXiv 2026 的论文在LLM的大力帮助下被写出, GPT论文由LLMs通过建筑来作曲,ACL 2019论文在普及LLM辅助作曲之前就已出现. 以开放模式和克洛德模式进行的初步运行补充了GPT文件(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: ACL 2019 covers every venue in the ACL Anthology, including workshops and co-located events, so that the pre-LLM baseline reflects the same breadth of scientific NLP writing as arXiv 2026. arXiv metadata does not record which style file a paper uses, so arXiv 2026 keeps the cs.CL submissions of January to September 2026 whose comment field names an *ACL venue (e.g. “Accepted to ACL 2026”; 1,985 papers) and then confirms the ACL style in the L a T e X source (1,841 of the 1,973 downloaded). An automatic language filter excludes documents that are not usable English text: mostly French and Chinese papers in ACL 2019, and near-empty extractions in both corpora. All word counts and rates use body text, with references and appendices removed.
blocks.zh: ACL 2019覆盖了ACL Anthology的每个会场,包括讲习班和同地活动,因此LLM前期基线反映了与arXiv 2026相同的科学NLP写作宽度. arXiv元数据不记录纸张文件使用的样式,所以arXiv 2026保存了cs. 2026年1月至9月的CL提交书,其评论字段取出一个*ACL会场(如"Accepted to ACL 2026";1,985篇论文),再以L a T e X源确认ACL风格(1,973所下载的1,841篇). 一个自动语言过滤器排除了无法使用英文文本的文档:大部分是ACL 2019中的法语和中文论文,以及两个corpora中的近空取出. 所有字数和分数都使用正文,并去掉引用和附录.

blocks.en: Body length rises by 67% from 2019 to 2026 (Table 7 ), but most of the gap reflects paper format. Over a third of the ACL 2019 papers (37.6%) are short papers, against 3.6% of the arXiv 2026 papers, and comparing long papers only narrows the gap to 36% (8-page ACL 2019 papers, between the two formats, and arXiv papers under 500 words are left out of this comparison). A second, unpaginated source of length growth is Limitations and Ethics Statement sections: ACL conferences began requiring or strongly encouraging these only after 2019, and, like references, they do not count against the page limit. Excluding them narrows the long-paper gap further, to 14%, leaving a residual difference in the page-limited content itself (Appendix B ). Rates per 1,000 words are unaffected by length; counts per paper, used in the encounter model (Section 5.2 ), are affected.
blocks.zh: 体长从2019年到2026年上升了67%(表7),但大部分差距反映了纸张格式. blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Each of our four questions (Section 1 ) calls for a different kind of evidence (Table 2 ). Q1 concerns frequency: how often the construction occurs in each corpus. We count rather than and related antithesis patterns with regular expressions over the body text of each paper and normalize per 1,000 words (Section 4.1 ), including in papers that LLMs write and then revise from the title and abstract of a real paper (Section 4.2 ). Frequency alone does not show that the construction is a problem, since rather than has many legitimate uses. Q2 therefore calls for reader judgments: two of the authors, both NLP researchers with years of experience after PhD, labeled a sample of occurrences as annoying or legitimate, without knowing which corpus each came from (Section 4.3 ). Q3 concerns what distinguishes the annoying uses. Reading them suggested two hypotheses: that the rejected alternative is often a straw man, a position no competent author would hold, and that there is something about the annoying uses that suggests that they praise the affirmed alternative and disparage the rejected one. We test both, and also compare the syntax and semantic similarity of annoying and legitimate uses (Section 4.4 ). Q4 concerns where the construction comes from. Its rise coincides with post-training on preference data, so we test whether the raters behind open preference datasets favor responses that use it, whether open reward models prefer a sentence with the construction to the same sentence without it, and whether an instruction to be “honest” makes models use it more often (Section 4.5 ). Section 4.6 describes the statistical tests.
blocks.zh: 我们的四个问题(第1节)都要求有不同的证据(表2)。 问题1涉及频率:每个体件的构造发生频率. 我们用每份文件正文的正文表达方式来计算而不是相关的反理论模式,并且使每1,000个字的表达正常化(第4.1节),包括在LLMs所写的文件中,然后从真实文件的标题和抽象中修改(第4.2节)。 仅靠频率并不能表明建筑是一个问题,因为建造不是有许多合法用途。 因此,问题2要求读者做出判断:两位作者,两位都是在博士后有多年经验的NLP研究人员,将一些事件标榜为令人讨厌或合法的,而不知道每个事件都来自哪一个实体(第4.3节)。 问题3涉及如何区分烦人的用途。 阅读它们后提出了两个假设:被否决的替代方案往往是稻草人,一个没有胜任的作者会采取的立场,有些令人厌烦的用途暗示他们称赞被否决的替代方案并贬低被否决的替代方案. 我们同时检验,并比较烦恼和合法用途的语法和语义相似性(第4.4节)。 Q4关注施工来源. 其上升与优惠数据培训后同时进行,因此我们测试开放优惠数据集背后的评分者是否倾向于使用该数据集的响应,开放奖励模型是否偏好与构造的句子,而不是没有该词的句子,以及是否一个“诚实”的指令使模型更经常地使用(第4.5节)。 第4.6节描述了统计测试。

blocks.en: 4.1 Antithesis patterns
blocks.zh: 4.1 反理论模式

blocks.en:
‘‘Rather than’’ is one surface form of a more general rhetorical move: negate (or downplay) an alternative, then affirm the real claim. We extend the frequency analysis to seven further constructions in the same family, 8 8 8 We leave out in contrast . It is mostly a discourse connective that links a sentence to the one before (“In contrast, …”), so the alternative it sets against lies outside the sentence and is often not rejected at all. In our human spot check (Section 4.1 ), 4 of 5 ACL 2019 matches and none of 5 arXiv 2026 matches were instances of the construction; the rejected ones were all sentence-initial connectives. grouped into three types by how directly they realize that relation: substitution connectives, direct syntactic siblings of “rather than” ( instead of , as opposed to ); negation , canonical negate-then-affirm antithesis ( not X but Y ; X, not Y postposed); and emphatic pivot constructions, which we take to be the closest match to the paper’s actual complaint about LLM writing that states what it does not do before saying what it does ( not only/just/merely X but Y ; it’s not X, it’s Y ; this is not to say ).
Our analysis is based on
regex heuristics over raw text, without parsing. To estimate their precision, GPT-6-sol judged 50 random matches per pattern and corpus against a pattern-specific description of the construction (Table 5 ). The substitution connectives and not only/just/merely X but Y are near-exact. Not X but Y and the postposed X, not Y are noisier, mostly in the PDF-extracted ACL 2019 text, where a comma before “not” or a clause-level “but” often has nothing to do with antithesis. A human check of 20 matches of each of these two patterns per corpus agreed with the judge (Cohen’s κ = 0.79 \kappa=0.79 for both) and gives similar precision ( X, not Y : 35% and 75%; not X but Y : 65% and 95%), and 10 matches each of rather than and not only/just/merely X but Y were instances for both. Recall is not estimated. The two rarest emphatic patterns are too sparse to interpret at this corpus size and are left out of the frequency results.

blocks.en: 4.2 Generating papers with LLMs
blocks.zh: 4.2 用法学硕士编写论文

blocks.en: The GPT papers are generated from the title and abstract of real papers: 200 ACL 2019 and 200 arXiv 2026 papers, drawn at random from the papers that remain after the exclusions of Section 3 . Three OpenAI models (GPT-4o, GPT-5.6-sol and GPT-6-sol) each process the same papers in three stages. Generation : one request per paper, with a system prompt casting the model as an NLP researcher writing for an ACL conference and an instruction to write an ACL-style paper of about 8 pages (6,400 words), with the sections of an empirical paper, a Limitations section and no appendices, from the title and abstract alone; the rest of the source paper never enters the prompt. Review : GPT-4o, prompted as an ACL reviewer, writes a structured review (summary, strengths, weaknesses, suggestions, questions, overall assessment) focused on methodology and evidence. Revision : the generating model, prompted as the paper’s author, rewrites the whole paper in response to the review. This tests the hypothesis that rather than becomes more frequent as a model revises already-drafted text. None of the prompts contains rather than or another antithesis construction (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: GPT论文出自真实论文的标题和抽象:200 ACL 2019和200 arXiv 2026等论文,从第3节被排除在外后所留下的论文中随机取出. 三种OpenAI模型(GPT-4o,GPT-5.6-sol和GPT-6-sol)各分三个阶段处理同论文. 生成:每纸一份请求,系统即刻将模型铸成NLP研究员为ACL会议作文,并指示撰写ACL风格的论文约8页(6,400字),其中部分为经验性论文,限制部分和没有附录,仅取自标题和抽象;其余出处的出处纸从未入出. 评论:GPT-4o作为ACL评论员受到启发,撰写了以方法和证据为重点的结构化评论(摘要,长处,弱点,建议,问题,全面评估). 订正:作为论文作者的促动,该生成模型根据评论改写了整篇论文。 这检验了一种假设,即与其像模型那样更频繁地修订已经起草的案文。 提示中没有一个包含而不是另一个反理论构造(Appendix D.).

blocks.en: To see whether the construction is specific to OpenAI models, and at which stage of post-training it enters a model, the same pipeline, with the same prompts and GPT-4o as reviewer, is run on the first 100 of the GPT papers’ sources (50 ACL 2019, 50 arXiv 2026; Table 7 ) with two further families. Open models : the checkpoints of Tülu 3 8B ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) after supervised fine-tuning (SFT), after preference optimization (DPO), and after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (the final model), which share data and recipe and differ only in the post-training stage. Claude : Claude Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5. These runs were not annotated for annoyance; Appendix E gives the settings of every model.
blocks.zh: 为了了解建造是否是OpenAI模型的特异性,以及培训后进入模型的哪个阶段,同一管道以相同的提示和GPT-4o作为审查者,运行在GPT论文的前100个来源(50 ACL 2019,50 arXiv 2026;表7)上,还有另外两个家庭. 开放型号:Tülu 3 8B(Lambert等,2025年)经过监督微调(SFT)后,经过优惠优化(DPO)后,经过可核查奖励的强化学习(最终型号)后,这些检查站共享数据和食谱,仅在培训后阶段有所不同. 克洛德:克洛德·海库 4.5,索内 5.5和奥普斯 5.5. 这些运行没有因烦恼而附加注释;附录E给出了每个模型的设置.

blocks.en: 4.3 Human annotation
blocks.zh: 4.3 人类注释

blocks.en: We annotate a sample of rather than occurrences, each extracted with its containing sentence and document provenance. The pool has 1,000 items in two batches, labeled on different days: random samples of ACL 2019 and arXiv 2026 occurrences, samples from the first and latest arXiv versions of revised papers, and occurrences from the arXiv 2026 papers with the most uses of the construction (high-count papers; Table 7 ). No occurrence appears in the pool twice. The first batch balances ACL 2019 and arXiv 2026. The second favors arXiv 2026, whose uses inform the analysis of what makes a use annoying , and keeps some ACL 2019 uses, since the share of a category in a sample can shift how readily annotators apply it ( Levari et al., 2018 ) . Occurrences were drawn from the full text of each paper, while the rates in Section 5.1 use body text only; 33 of the 1,000 items (3.3%) lie in references or appendices, and leaving them out changes no annoying rate by more than 1.5 percentage points (Appendix J ). Appendix J gives the sampling details.
blocks.zh: 我们用它包含的句子和文件来源来说明一个样本,而不是发生的情况。 该池分两批有1000个物品,贴有不同日期的标签:ACL 2019和arXiv 2026发生地的随机样本,修订文件的第一版和最新版本arXiv的样本,以及建筑用途最多的arXiv 2026文件的出处(高清文件;表7). 游泳池里没有出现两次。 第一批余额为ACL 2019和arXiv 2026. 第二个偏好是arXiv 2026, 其用途为分析何为令人厌烦的用途提供了依据, 并保留一些 ACL 2019 用途, 因为一个类别在样本中的份额可以改变一个类别如何容易地应用它(Levari等, 2018年)。 从每份文件的全文中得出了缺漏,而第5.1节中的比率仅使用正文;在1 000项中,有33项(3.3%)在参考书目或附录中取出,没有超过1.5个百分点的变化(附录J)。 附 录 J给出了样本的细节.

blocks.en: Items are presented one at a time in a web interface showing the sentence with the occurrence highlighted, together with the preceding and following sentence. Source corpus and document are hidden, and the order is shuffled. Annotators assign one of four labels: annoying if the use annoys them, legitimate (legit) if it does not, unsure if they cannot decide, or garbled when extraction has left the text unreadable. Annoying is defined by the annotator’s reaction alone; the instructions say to mark a use annoying if it annoys the annotator, for whatever reason. 9 9 9 The page was originally designed to give one example of each of the first two labels; the annoying example is illustrative and rejects an alternative nobody would choose (Appendix C ), which may have drawn attention to straw men, the hypothesis we test later (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 项目在网络界面中一次介绍,显示句子与突出的发生,以及上句和下句. 源体和文档被隐藏,顺序被打乱. 注释者在四个标签中指定一个标签:如果使用引起烦恼,如果使用不当,合法(合法),如果无法决定,不确定,或者在取出后使文本无法读取时被粘住。 引起注意只是由注释者的反应来定义的;指示说,如果引起注释者的烦恼,无论出于何种原因,就表示使用烦恼。 第9条 9 该页最初旨在举出前两个标签中每个标签的一例;令人烦恼的例子是说明性的,并拒绝无人会选择的替代办法(附录C),这可能会引起人们注意稻草人,我们稍后测试的假设(第4.4节).

blocks.en: Five annotators took part (Table 3 ). All are NLP researchers who volunteered and use LLMs in their own writing, and all are non-native speakers of English at a highly proficient (C2-equivalent) level; A1 has lived in the US for 17 years. A1 and A2 routinely review for *ACL conferences. A1 and A2 labeled all 1,000 items independently; A1 to A4 also coded a subset of the items for straw men (Section 4.4 ). A1 and A2 are both authors of this paper and expected the 2026 uses to annoy them more often. The labels were made early in the study, blind to corpus and document, so this expectation could not be applied to individual items, but it may have raised the annotators’ attention to the construction overall. Each annotator saw the items in a different random order and did not see the other’s labels. Judgments made over a long annotation effort can drift, so we measure the drift: for each annotator and batch, 40 items from early in their order were shown again later under new identifiers and re-labeled blind among the remaining items. The repeated items, and items an annotator marked garbled , are excluded when computing rates. Labeling can also change what an annotator notices: reading many uses, forming ideas about them and tiring can sharpen an annotator’s eye for some uses over time, and A1 reported such effects. Since the second batch was labeled after the first had been analyzed, we recompute each label-based result within each batch and report which results hold in an annotator’s first batch alone (Appendix K ).

A1和A2例行审查*ACL会议。 A1和A2将所有1 000件物品单独标出标签;A1至A4还为稻草人编码了一部分物品(第4.4节)。 A1和A2都是本文的作者,预计2026年的用法会更经常地惹恼他们. 这些标签在研究初期就被打出,对文书和文件视而不见,因此这种期望不能适用于个别物品,但可能已使注释者注意到整个建筑工程。 每个注释员都以不同的随机顺序看到这些物品,没有看到对方的标签. 长时间的注解努力所作的判决可以漂移,因此,我们测量了漂移情况:对于每个注解员和批次来说,早期的40个项目后来在新的识别符下再次显示,其余项目中被重新贴上盲号。 重复的项目和标有格子的注释器在计算率时不包括在内。 标签也可以改变一个注释员的通告:读取许多用途,形成关于这些用途的想法和疲劳,可以使一个注释员的眼睛在一段时间内对一些用途更加敏锐,A1报告了这种影响。 由于第二批是在对第一批货物进行了分析后贴上标签的,因此我们重新计算每批中每一批基于标签的结果,并报告这些结果只存在于一个注释员的第一批中(附录K)。

blocks.en: To compare uses in GPT papers with uses in real papers directly, A1 and A2 also labeled a separate set, the GPT comparison set: uses from GPT papers, mixed with arXiv 2026 and a smaller share of ACL 2019 uses from papers other than the GPT papers’ sources (Table 7 ), shuffled and shown without their source. It has 313 uses: uses from Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 papers, balanced across the two models and across first drafts and revisions; uses from GPT-6-sol papers of the same source papers, as the comparison; and ACL 2019 uses as fillers. Only A1 has labeled it so far, with ten hidden repeats, all of which received the same label; results for this set are A1’s alone, and A2’s labels will be added. Fifty-five of the Claude uses and the fillers belong to a smaller batch that A1 labeled earlier, before the rest. The hypothesis comes from the stance results, which preceded the labeling of the larger set. Haiku 4.5, which finished later, is not in the set.

blocks.en: 4.4 Characterizing uses
blocks.zh: 4.4 说明用途

blocks.en: The analyses below compare annoying and legitimate arXiv 2026 items. Each analysis is run on three label sets: A1’s labels, A2’s labels, and a combined set, Either . In Either , an item counts as annoying if at least one annotator labeled it annoying , and as legitimate only if both annotators labeled it legitimate; any other item (for example, legitimate for one annotator and unsure for the other) is left out. A pattern that holds in all three sets reflects more than one reader’s taste.
blocks.zh: 以下分析比较了令人讨厌和合法的arXiv 2026物品。 每项分析在三套标签上进行: A1的标签, A2的标签和组合, 在其中之一中,如果至少有一个注释者将其贴上令人讨厌的标签,那么物品就被认为是令人烦恼的,而且只有在两个注释者都贴上合法的标签时才是合法的;任何其他物品(例如,对于一个注释者来说是合法的,对于另一个则不确定)则被排除在外。 所有三套图案都反映了读者的口味。

blocks.en: To test whether annoying uses are also judged more often to reject straw men, we code Y as a straw man when it names something no competent author in the field would seriously adopt or defend (an absolute claim, an error or cheat, or a naive simplification nobody currently uses), and as not a straw man when it is a real option a reader might assume (an existing method, a common default, a design choice). The definition was illustrated with invented examples and tried on a development set (Table 4 ). The test set consists of 121 arXiv 2026 items drawn by their annoyance label: every first-batch item one annotator labeled annoying , and a random sample of the items that annotator labeled legitimate. 10 10 10 The annotator was A1, whose labels were the only annoyance labels when the straw-man coding began. Four coders coded Y in both sets, shuffled, seeing each sentence with Y highlighted and its context, without any annoyance label: the two annotators, and A3 and A4, who took no part in the annoyance annotation (Table 3 ). Their only instructions were those shown on the annotation pages (Appendix C ). Since the items are sampled by their annoyance label and coded without it, comparing how often straw men occur among annoying and legitimate items is a test of whether the two go together (a case-control design), though not an estimate of how common straw men are overall. Generally, we have found that coding for straw men is hard (Appendix R ).
blocks.zh: 为了检验是否也更经常地判断烦人的用法是拒绝吸管人,我们把Y作为吸管人,当它点出一个该领域没有任何合格作者会认真接受或捍卫的东西(绝对主张、错误或作弊,或目前无人使用的天真简化),当它是读者可能假设的真正选择(现有方法、常见的默认、设计选择)时,它就不是吸管人。 该定义以发明的例子来说明,并尝试了开发集(表4)。 测试集由121 arXiv 2026 个由他们的烦恼标签所绘制的物品组成: 每个第一批物品都有一个标记烦恼的注释者,以及一个随机抽样的注释者所标记的合法物品. 10 10 注释者是 A1,其标签是稻草人编码开始时唯一的烦恼标签. 4名编码员在两套中都编码了Y,被打乱了,看到每个句子都用Y来突出其上下文,没有带任何烦恼的标签:两个注释员,以及A3和A4没有参与烦恼的注释(表3). 他们唯一的指示是在注释页(附录C)上显示的。 由于这些物品是用它们烦恼的标签取样的,并且没有这种标签进行编码,因此,比较吸管男子在烦恼和合法物品中发生的频率,是检验两者是否并存的(个案控制设计),虽然不是对吸管男子总体常见程度的估计. 一般来说,我们发现稻草人的编码很困难(附录R)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Items coded for straw men. Test items are first-batch arXiv 2026 items; development items are outside the test set.
blocks.zh: 表4:为稻草人编码的项目。 试验品为第一批arXiv 2026等;开发品为试验品外.

blocks.en: We test whether the rather than construction often praises the affirmed alternative X and disparages the rejected alternative Y (‘meaningful signals rather than artifacts’), and whether that is annoying . This should correlate with straw men, but is easier to test. We tested this as follows. GPT-6-sol rated how favorably the author presents X and Y, each from − 2 -2 (clearly disparaged) to + 2 +2 (clearly favored), from the passage alone, with X and Y marked and without the annotators’ labels; the prompt gave three invented examples. We predicted that the gap between X and Y is larger, and Y lower, for annoying than for legitimate items, and that Y is lower for items coded as straw men. The rating concerns the author’s stance, whatever the syntactic role, so it also covers inverted uses, in which the author favors the rejected alternative and X is rated below Y. Y may be the author’s own approach (“prior work optimizes X rather than Y”), or a better option the authors did not pursue and defend not pursuing (“the design is intentionally diagnostic rather than a complete simulation of deployment”). We also compare the ratings of random uses across corpora, and run the tests on the non-inverted items alone (X rated at least as high as Y), to separate a stronger contrast from the mere absence of inverted uses. A1 checked the rating blind on 80 arXiv 2026 items, 40 rated inverted and 40 not, by judging which alternative the author presents more favorably, without seeing the ratings (Appendix Q ). A second rater, Claude run as independent agents with the same instructions and passages, rated 549 uses again (same appendix).
blocks.zh: 以及这是否令人厌烦。 这应该与稻草人有关,但更容易测试。 我们测试如下。 GPT-6-Sol对作者给出的X和Y的评分如何偏好,从− 2 - 2 (明显贬低)到+ 2 + 2 (明显偏好),从单行道,用X和Y标记,没有注释者的标签;提示给出了三个发明的例子. 我们预测,X和Y之间的差距更大,Y的差距更小,因为令人讨厌的物品比合法物品要小,而Y的差距更小,因为编码为稻草人的物品。 评分涉及作者的立场,而不论综合作用如何,因此它也涵盖倒置的用途,其中作者偏爱被否决的替代品而X评分低于Y. Y可能是作者自己的做法( " 工作前优化X而不是Y " ),也可能是作者没有追求和捍卫不追求的更好选择( " 设计是有意的诊断而不是完全模拟部署 " )。 我们还比较了整个蝎子的随机用途的分数,单独对非倒置物品进行测试(X评分至少为Y分),以区分出一个更强烈的对比,而仅仅是没有倒置用途. A1在80 arXiv 2026项,40项被评为倒数和40项没有被评为盲分时,通过判断作者给出的更有利的选择,没有看到评分(附录Q. 第二批评人克洛德作为独立代理人运行,其指令和段落相同,被评为549再次使用(同为附录).

blocks.en: Another property we test for correlation with annoyance is disavowal: the authors calibrate the status of their own claim, either declining a stronger one (“a hypothesis rather than a tested mechanism”) or rejecting a deflating characterization of their work (“a general method rather than one calibration procedure”). Two LLM coders, Claude (run as independent agents) and GPT-6-sol, classified each use from the passage with X and Y marked, without any label or rating, as a disavowal, an approach contrast (a technical choice), a finding contrast (what a finding is) or other (Appendix G gives the instructions). A use counts as a disavowal when both coders say so. They coded the uses of the Claude comparison set, the GPT comparison set and the pool sample rated for stance.
blocks.zh: 我们检验与烦恼相关的另一个财产是否定:作者们校正他们自己诉求的状况,要么拒绝一个更强烈的诉求(“假设而不是一个经过测试的机制”),要么拒绝对其作品进行夸大定性(“一种一般方法而不是一种校正程序”)。 两个LLM编码器Claude(作为独立代理运行)和GPT-6-sol(GPT-6-sol)将X和Y标记的通道中的每一个用法归类为否定,一个方法对比(技术选择),一个发现对比(什么是发现)或其他(附录G给出指示). 当两位编码员都这么说时,使用就算是一种否定. 他们编码了克劳德比较集,GPT比较集和被评为姿态的池样的用法.

blocks.en: We compare the syntax of annoying and legitimate items without a preselected list of features. Each sentence is parsed with spaCy ( en_core_web_sm ; Honnibal et al., 2020 ), and every pattern the parse yields is collected: whether Rather than opens the sentence; how than and rather attach (dependency label and the tag of the head); the tag and dependency label of the heads of X and Y, and their pair of tags, where X is the head that than attaches to and Y its complement or the following conjunct; the tag of the main-clause root and the type of its subject; and every part-of-speech tag, dependency label and arc (head tag, label, dependent tag) in the sentence. A pattern counts once per sentence. Every pattern that at least five items have and at least five lack is tested with Fisher’s exact test, with Benjamini-Hochberg correction over all tested patterns in each label set; in the GPT comparison set, Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel tests control for corpus. We also test whether annoying items resemble one another in meaning. For each item we embed four units with text-embedding-3-large : X and Y (extracted by GPT-6-sol as exact substrings of the sentence; 991 of 1,000 items have a valid pair), the sentence, and the paragraph (the sentence with two sentences on either side). For each unit and label set, we compute the share of each annoying item’s five nearest neighbors that are also annoying , against label permutations, and compare the mean pairwise cosine similarity among the annoying items with that of random sets of the same size. Pairs of items from the same paper are excluded throughout.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了烦人和合法物品的语法,没有预选的特征列表. 每句话都用温泉解析 Cy(en_core_web_sm;Honnibal等,2020年)),并收集了每个解析的分量:是否不是打开句子;如何和附加(头部的依赖性标签和标记);X和Y头部的标记和依赖性标签,以及他们的一对标记,其中X是头部,而不是被附着和Y的辅料或以下相接;主声根的标记及其主体的类型;句子中每个部分的语音标记,依赖性标签和弧(头部标记,标签,依赖性标签). 一个图案每句算一次. 费舍尔的准确测试测试了至少五件物品和至少五件短缺的每件图案,其中Benjamini-Hochberg校正了每个标签集中所有被测试的图案;在GPT比较集中,Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel测试控制了生物体。 我们还检验烦人物品在含义上是否相似。 我们为每个项目嵌入了四个单元,其中包含3个大文本: X和Y (由GPT-6-sol取出作为句子的精确下弦;千项中的991个有有效对),句子和段子(句子两边有两句). 对于每个单元和标签,我们对照标签的排列来计算每个烦人的近邻五个也烦人的相邻者的份额,并比较烦人的相邻物品与同大小的随机相邻物品之间的平均对等余弦相似性。 同一文件的一对物品在整个过程中都排除在外。

blocks.en: Annoyance could simply be a reaction to text that reads as LLM-written, for whatever reason. To test this, A1 and A2 also judged short passages (three sentences) from the papers behind pool items, on a hunch, as written by a person or by an LLM, on a four-point scale (human, probably human, probably LLM, LLM). Nothing was highlighted, most passages lie outside the context the annotators had judged, and most contain no antithesis construction. The sample covers every paper with an item either annotator labeled annoying , random papers with only legitimate items, and a few ACL 2019 papers, the only passages of known authorship. For each paper, we correlate the mean hunch with the share of its pool items each annotator labeled annoying . A3 and A5, who never judged annoyance, judged a larger set on the same scale: every item either annotator labeled annoying and a random sample of the rest, passages around the sentences with “rather than” uses in ACL 2019 papers and in GPT papers, and fillers (passages from the same papers that contain no antithesis construction). Our predictions were: passages of annoying items read as more LLM-written than passages of legitimate items; passages with the construction read as more LLM-written than fillers; and GPT passages read as more LLM-written than ACL 2019 passages, also when the GPT paper was written from an ACL 2019 paper.
blocks.zh: 无论出于何种原因,不安可能只是对作为LLM书写的文本的反应。 为了检验这一点,A1和A2还根据一个人或LLM所写的直觉,从池子项目背后的论文中判断出短段(三句),以四分尺度(人,可能为人,可能为LLM,LLM)来判断. 没有突出任何内容,大多数段落是在注释者判断的背景之外,大多数段落没有包含反理论构造。 样本覆盖每份纸上都有标有"烦人"标签的注释者,随机的纸上只有合法物品,还有少数ACL 2019纸上,是已知作者身份的唯一一行. 对每篇论文来说,我们把平均直觉与每篇标有烦人的注解者 的池子物品份额联系起来。 A3和A5从未判断过烦恼,在同一个尺度上判断了更大的一组:每个标有烦恼标签的标注器和随机抽取了其余的样本,在句子周围用"而不是"在ACL 2019年论文和GBT论文中的用法,以及填充器(来自同样论文的没有反理论构造的通道). 我们的预测是:令人烦恼的物品的段落读作比合法物品的段落多LLM写作;与构造相伴的段落读作比填充器多LLM写作;与ACL 2019段落相伴的GPT段落读作比LL写作多LLM写作,同样是在GBT论文取自ACL 2019论文时.

blocks.en: 4.5 Preference data and honesty instructions
blocks.zh: 4.5 优先数据和诚实说明

blocks.en: The rise of the construction coincides with post-training by preference optimization ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , in which a model learns from pairs of responses to the same prompt, one marked as chosen and one as rejected by human raters or an LLM judge. If raters favor a construction even slightly, training on their preferences can turn that into a strong habit. We test this in four open preference datasets used to post-train open models, two rated by LLM judges and two by people: UltraFeedback ( Cui et al., 2024 ) , 61k pairs rated by GPT-4; the Tülu 3 preference mixture ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) , 270k pairs rated by GPT-4o on helpfulness, instruction following, honesty and truthfulness, with responses from 24 models of several families; and HelpSteer2 and HelpSteer3 ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ) , 7k and 22k pairs with human pairwise preferences (ties dropped; for HelpSteer3, the English general and STEM domains). For each pair we record whether each antithesis pattern occurs in the chosen and in the rejected response, and fit a conditional logistic model of which response is chosen on the difference in pattern presence and in log length, since longer responses are preferred ( Singhal et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 建造的兴起与通过优化优惠(Rafailov等,2023年)进行后期培训相吻合,其中模型从对同一快件的对接中学习,一个被标为所选择,一个被人类评分者或LLM法官所拒绝. 如果评分者稍稍偏爱建设,那么关于他们的偏好的培训就可能成为一种很强的习惯。 我们用四个开放的首选数据集测试这一点, 用于培训后开放模型, 两个由LLM评委评分, 两个由人评分: UltraFeedback(Cui等,2024年),61克对由GPT-4评出;Tülu 3 偏好混合物(Lambert等,2025年),270克对由GPT-4o评出,内容为帮助性,遵循指导,诚实和诚实,由多个家庭的24个模型响应;和HelpSteer2和HelpSteer3(Wang等,2025a; Wang et al., 2025b.),有人类对等偏好(ties dropp;为HelpSteer3,为英语通称和STEM域名)的7k和22k对. 对于每一对,我们记录在所选反应中和被否决反应中是否出现每个反理论模式,并采用有条件的后勤模型,根据模式存在和对数长度的不同来选择反应,因为更倾向于较长的反应(Singhal等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Honesty is one of the three aims of the “helpful, honest and harmless” assistant ( Askell et al., 2021 ) , and it is one of the four aspects the UltraFeedback and Tülu 3 judges rate. UltraFeedback defines it as follows: “LLMs should know what they (don’t) know and express uncertainty towards the given problem” ( Cui et al., 2024 , §2.1) . The construction of UltraFeedback allows a direct test of what an honesty instruction does to a model’s writing. Each of its 256k completions was generated with a principle drawn at random and added to the system prompt (helpfulness, honesty, truthfulness, verbalized calibration, or harmlessness; about eleven wordings each), and the release records the principle of each completion. Since the principle was assigned at random within each source dataset, a difference in the use of a construction between principles is an effect of the instruction. We compared each principle with helpfulness in a logistic regression with source dataset and generating model as fixed effects and log length as covariate; the prediction was that the honesty principle raises rather than .
blocks.zh: 诚实是“帮助、诚实和无害”助理的三个目标之一(Askell等人,2021年),也是UltraFeedback和Tülu 3法官比率的四个方面之一。 UltraFeedback对它的定义如下:“LLMs应该知道他们(不知道)知道什么,并对特定问题表示不确定性”(Cui等,2024年,第2.1节)。 UltraFeedback的构造可以直接测试诚实指示对模型写作的作用. 其256克的完成均以随机抽取的原则生成,并加入系统即时(帮助性、诚实性、真实性、口语校正或无害性;各约11个措辞),发布记录了每次完成的原则。 由于该原理是在每个源数据集中随机分配的,所以原理之间使用构思的不同是指令的效果. 我们把每项原则与逻辑回归中的有用性与源数据集进行比较,并将生成模型作为固定效应和对数长度作为共变;预测是诚实原则提出而不是提出。

blocks.en: The preference data compare different responses, so they cannot isolate the clause itself. We therefore score minimal pairs with open reward models. From the pool items of the first annotation batch (Table 24 ) we form two versions of the sentence, as written and with the rather than Y clause deleted, and score both with four Skywork-Reward-V2 models ( Liu and others, 2025 ) (Qwen3 0.6B, 1.7B and 8B, and Llama-3.1 8B). Each version is the assistant turn of a conversation whose user turn gives the preceding sentence of the paper and asks for the next one; a positive difference means the model prefers the version with the clause. Deleting a clause also shortens the sentence and removes content, so we add a length control: Y is replaced by a non-contrastive clause of the same length (within one word), written for each item by Claude Opus 5.5 and checked to contain no contrast marker. We also rate the sentiment of the three versions (original, control, deleted) from − 2 -2 to + 2 +2 with GPT-6-sol, each text on its own and without context, and test whether the reward differences survive holding the sentiment difference fixed (a regression of the reward difference on the sentiment difference, with log clause length as covariate for original versus deleted). Differences are tested with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests.
blocks.zh: 偏好数据比较不同的答复,因此不能孤立条款本身. 因此,我们得分最低对 公开奖励模式。 从第一批注解的池子项目(表24)中,我们组成了两个版本的句子,由书面写出并删除了而不是Y条款,同时以四个"Skywork-Reward-V2"模型(刘等,2025年)(Quen3 0.6B,1.7B和8B,和Llama-3.1 8B)来评分. 每个版本都是对话的助手转会,其用户转会给出了纸张的前一句并询问下一句;一个正差意味着模型更喜欢带有条款的版本. 删除一个条款也会缩短句子并去掉内容,所以我们添加一个长度控制: Y被同长度(一字之内)的非相容条款所取而代之,由克洛德·奥普斯·5.5为每件物品写出,并检查后不包含相相容标记. 我们还将三种版本(原始、控制、已删除)的情绪从− 2 - 2 到+ 2 + 2 与 GPT-6- sol, 每种文本单独进行,没有上下文, 并测试奖励差异是否仍然维持不变的情绪差异(对情绪差异的奖励差异的回归, 对原始和已删除的逻辑条款长度为共变量)。 差异通过威尔克逊签名排名测试.

blocks.en: 4.6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 分析

blocks.en: Annoying rates carry Wilson 95% intervals. Group differences are tested with Fisher’s exact test for proportions and the Mann-Whitney test for scores, and with logistic regressions that include stratum fixed effects where items come from several strata; where many features are compared, p p -values are adjusted with the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. The procedures and predictions of the evaluative-stance tests, the tests of AI tells and research domain reported in Section 5.3 , and the honesty-principle test were committed to the code repository beforehand, and these tests are one-sided in the predicted direction. The straw-man hypothesis arose from reading the labeled data. The predictions for A3’s and A5’s authorship judgments were committed to the code repository before the judgments were collected. The syntactic scan, the preference-data comparisons and the analysis of A1’s and A2’s authorship hunches are exploratory.
blocks.zh: 惊人的比率与威尔逊95%的间隔。 团体差异是通过Fisher精确的比例测试和Mann-Whitney的分数测试进行测试的,逻辑回归包括来自多个阶层的物品的分层固定效应;在比较许多特性时,p - 值根据Benjamini-Hochberg程序进行调整。 评估-恒定测试的程序和预测、AI的测试以及第5.3节所报道的研究领域,以及诚实原则测试都是事先投入到代码存储器的,这些测试都是片面的,偏向于预测的方向. 稻草人假说产生于阅读被标注的数据. 对A3和A5著作权判决的预测是在收集判决之前交给编码存放处的。 综合扫描、偏好数据比较以及A1和A2作者的直觉分析都是探索性的。

blocks.en: Several features of the design guard against the most likely sources of bias. The annotators did not know which corpus an item came from (Section 4.3 ). The straw-man coders never saw the annoyance labels, each annotator’s labels are compared only with other people’s codes, and two of the coders never judged annoyance (Section 4.4 ). The LLM judgments that carry a result were checked against human judgments, for pattern precision (Section 4.1 ) and for the stance rating (Appendix Q ), and the GPT papers were checked for verbatim copying from their sources (Appendix F ). The honesty test rests on the random assignment of system prompts in UltraFeedback, and the main predictions were committed before the data were produced or the test was run.
blocks.zh: 设计中的一些特征防止最有可能的偏见来源. 注释者不知道物品来自哪个实体(第4.3节)。 稻草人编码师从未见过烦恼标签,每个注释师的标签只比作其他人的代码,两个编码师从未判断烦恼(第4.4节). 对附有结果的LLM判决与人类判决进行了核对,以确定模式精确度(第4.1节)和立场评级(附录Q),并核对了GPT文件的出处(附录F)。 诚实测试基于UltraFeedback中系统提示的随机分配,主要预测是在数据生成或测试运行之前完成的.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: The results follow the four questions of Section 1 (Table 2 ). The construction has become far more frequent (Q1, Section 5.1 ); annotators find some of its uses annoying , almost only in 2026 papers (Q2, Section 5.2 ); the annoying uses differ from the legitimate ones in how they treat the rejected alternative (Q3, Section 5.3 ); and preference data and reward models used in post-training reward the construction (Q4, Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 结果与第1节(表2)的四个问题相接。 建造已变得更加频繁(问题1, 第5.1节); 注释者发现其某些用途令人烦恼, 几乎只在2026年的论文(问题2, 第5.2节); 令人烦恼的用途在如何对待被拒绝的替代品方面与合法用途不同(问题3, 第5.3节); 培训后奖励建筑时使用的优惠数据和奖励模式(问题4, 第5.4节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Frequency
blocks.zh: 5.1 频率

blocks.en: Rather than has become far more frequent in 2026 papers, and even more so in the papers written by GPT-5.6-sol and GPT-6-sol. Figure 1 reports frequencies per 1,000 words for “rather than” and the broader antithesis family, comparing ACL 2019 with arXiv 2026. The rate of rather than in arXiv 2026 is about seven times the 2019 rate (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 而不是在2026年的论文中更加频繁,在GPT-5.6-sol和GPT-6-sol所写的论文中更为频繁. 图1为“而不是”和更广泛的反神论家族报告频率,将ACL 2019与arXiv 2026相比较。 2026年arXiv的比分而非比分约为2019年的7倍(表5).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Occurrences per 1,000 words, ACL 2019 vs. arXiv 2026 (1,821 papers).

blocks.en: The rise is uneven across the family (Table 5 ). The plain substitution connectives instead of and as opposed to become less frequent. Rather than and the postposed “X, not Y” rise most sharply, and “not X but Y” and the emphatic “not only/just/merely X but Y” rise modestly. Correcting for the lower precision of the two negation patterns in the 2019 PDF text makes the rise of “X, not Y” the steepest of all and leaves the others nearly unchanged. The rise is thus concentrated in rather than and the postposed negation, and the emphatic type shows one of the smaller increases.

blocks.en: The runs with open and Claude models use the first 100 source papers of the GPT papers (Table 7 ; the GPT rates are in Table 6 , for a larger set of sources). Two things stand out. First, the construction is not specific to OpenAI models: Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 use it in nearly every paper, at similar rates and below that of GPT-5.6-sol and GPT-6-sol. Second, post-training as such does not produce a high rate. The three Tülu 3 8B stages write short papers, like GPT-4o, and use the construction in a minority of papers at every stage. For the ACL 2019 sources they do not differ from the original authors, and for the arXiv 2026 sources they use it less than the original authors. Nothing in the table suggests that preference optimization or reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards adds the construction: the rate is no higher in the final model than after supervised fine-tuning. Heavy use appears instead in the commercial models, which agrees with locating the habit in their preference data and objectives (Section 6 ).

blocks.en: Where the Claude models and the source papers differ depends on the source corpus. For the ACL 2019 papers, all three Claude models use rather than significantly more often than the originals (paired Wilcoxon tests). For the arXiv 2026 papers none does, because the originals already use it at nearly the Claude rate. This is what one would expect if many arXiv 2026 authors wrote with the help of a model like these (Section 3 ), but the test cannot show it. Revision by the same model does not raise the rate of rather than consistently: Opus 5.5 raises it in both corpora, Haiku 4.5 in the ACL 2019 papers, Sonnet 5.5 in neither. Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 raise the postposed “X, not Y” substantially, as GPT-6-sol does, so that when these models revise, they add the contrast in another form, as the account in Section 6 predicts; Haiku 4.5 does not. At the level of sentences, however, a form that replaces a removed rather than is the exception, not the rule (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 克劳德模型和源文件的不同之处取决于源代码. 对于ACL 2019年的论文,克洛德三款模型都使用而非显著地多于原作(paired Wilcoxon tests). 对于ArXiv 2026的论文,没有人这样做,因为原作已经以接近克洛德的速率使用. 如果许多 arXiv 2026 作者在这样的模型的帮助下写作(第 3 节), 同一模式的修订没有提高、而不是一贯提高: Opus 5.5在"双子公司"中提出,"ACL"2019年论文"海库 4.5","索内"5.5"两作均未提出. Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5将后置的"X,不是Y"大幅提升,如GPT-6-sol所做的那样,因此当这些模型修改后,它们会像第6节的账户所预测的那样,以另一种形式加入对比; Haiku 4.5没有. 然而,在句子级别上,一种取代被删除的而不是例外的形式,而不是规则(附录H.

blocks.en: The Claude models are later than the earliest GPT model: GPT-4o dates from 2024, whereas Haiku 4.5 dates from 2025 and Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 are more recent still. We could not run an earlier Claude model (the Claude Code interface does not accept Claude 3 and 3.5 model names), so Tülu 3 8B, built on a 2024 Llama model, is the only model outside the GPT family from the period of GPT-4o, and the comparison of Claude with GPT-4o confounds model family with age.
blocks.zh: 克洛德模型晚于最早的GPT模型:GPT-4o可追溯至2024年,而Haiku 4.5可追溯至2025年,而Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5则更相近. 我们无法运行一个更早的克洛德模型(克洛德代码接口不接受克洛德3和3.5模型名称),因此以2024年Llama模型为基础的Tülu 3 8B是GPT家族之外唯一从GPT-4o时期开始的模型,而克洛德与GPT-4o的比较则将模型家族与年龄相混淆.

blocks.en: 5.2 Reader judgments

blocks.en: Annotators find almost no 2019 uses annoying and about one in ten 2026 uses. While the two annotators seldom agree on which uses annoy, about half of 2026 papers contain a use that annoys each of them.

blocks.en: Both annotators find a far larger share of arXiv 2026 than of ACL 2019 uses annoying (Table 8 ); they agree on the direction and differ in level. In high-count papers, the sentences with rather than annoy as often as a random sample of 2026 uses, or more often. Uses in the first and latest arXiv versions of the same papers annoy at similar rates, so revision does not visibly change the share of annoying uses (Appendix J ).

blocks.en: The annotators agree that most items are acceptable, and seldom on which ones are annoying (Table 9 ): Gwet’s AC1, which a rare category affects less than κ \kappa , is high, and κ \kappa and positive agreement are low. Each annotator is at least as consistent with themselves across hidden repeats as with each other, and agreement on annoying in particular is far lower between annotators than within one, so the disagreement reflects differences between annotators more than noise within an annotator. Agreement on which items annoy is higher in high-count papers than in the random arXiv 2026 sample. The two annoying sets are not nested: most of the uses that annoy A2, who labels fewer uses annoying , do not annoy A1. If the annotators judged uses on the same scale and A2 simply needed more to be annoyed, every use that annoys A2 would also annoy A1; the two react, at least in part, to different uses.
blocks.zh: 注释者一致认为,大多数项目是可以接受的,很少涉及哪些项目令人烦恼(表9): Gwet的AC1, 罕见类影响小于克帕, 每个注释者在隐藏的重复中至少与彼此一致,而尤其是关于烦人的约定在注释者之间远低于在注释者内部,因此分歧反映的是注释者之间的分歧多于注释者内部的噪音. 高点纸上关于引起麻烦的物品的协议高于随机arXiv 2026样本。 两套烦人的套件没有被打入巢穴:大多数烦恼A2的用法, 如果对同样规模的用途和A2进行判断的注释者只是需要更多来烦恼,使A2烦恼的每一种用途也会烦恼A1;两者至少部分地对不同的用途作出反应.

blocks.en: One potential confound is that the task itself becomes annoying over time. Hidden repeats are meant to measure that. Most hidden repeats keep their label, and few change into or out of annoying (Table 9 ). A1’s arXiv 2026 rate is the same in both batches, but A1’s few ACL 2019 annoying labels all come from the second, and A1’s arXiv 2026 rate is higher again in the GPT comparison set, which fits growing sensitization; A2’s rate is higher in the second batch than in the first (Appendix K ). Since items appear in random order, drift shifts the overall level of annoying labels for all strata alike, and comparisons between strata are less exposed to it than absolute rates (Appendix L ).
blocks.zh: 一个潜在的困惑是,任务本身随着时间推移变得烦人. 隐藏的重复是用来测量的。 大多数被隐藏的重复保留其标签,很少有变化进入或摆脱烦恼(表9). A1的arXiv 2026率在两批中都是一样的,但A1的少数ACL 2019烦人标签都出自第二批,而A1的arXiv 2026率在GPT比较集中再次更高,这符合不断增长的灵敏度;A2的第二批率比第一批高(附录K. 由于物品的出现顺序是随机的,漂移会改变所有阶层烦人标签的总水平,不同阶层之间的比较与其绝对率相比,其暴露度较低(附录L.

blocks.en: Although few uses annoy, most 2026 papers contain one that does (Table 10 ): about half of 2026 papers contain a use that annoys a given annotator, and nearly two thirds one that annoys at least one of them, against about 1% of 2019 papers. A 2026 paper uses the construction about eight times on average, a 2019 paper less than once. If we assume that each use annoys with the annotator’s per-use rate p p , independently of the paper’s other uses, then a paper with k k uses contains an annoying one with probability 1 − ( 1 − p ) k 1-(1-p)^{k} . The estimate would overstate the chance for papers with many uses if those papers used the construction more carefully, with a lower share of annoying uses. They do not: in the high-count papers, the share is about the same as in the random sample for A1 and higher for A2 (Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 尽管很少有人使用烦恼,但大多数2026年的论文都包含一个确实存在的问题(表10):大约2026年的论文中有一半包含一种使给定的注释者感到烦恼的用法,近三分之二的论文则至少让其中之一感到烦恼,而2019年的论文则有1%左右. 2026年一纸平均使用该建筑约8次,2019年一纸少一纸. 若我们假设每个用法对注解者p的人均使用率感到烦恼, 如果这些论文更仔细地使用构筑物,而烦人的用途比例会更低,那么,这一估计将过分夸大论文使用多种用途的机会。 它们不会:在高分数文件中,份额与A1的随机样本大致相同,而A2的随机样本则更高(表8)。

blocks.en: In the GPT comparison set (Table 8 ), neither annotator finds ACL 2019 uses annoying , as in the pool. Uses from GPT-6-sol papers annoy A2 more often than arXiv 2026 uses, and GPT-5.6-sol uses tend to; A1 finds neither more annoying than arXiv 2026 uses. Since many arXiv 2026 papers were probably written with substantial LLM assistance (Section 3 ), this compares text certainly written by an LLM with text probably written at least partly by one. Revision matters for GPT-5.6-sol: its uses in revised papers annoy both annotators far more often than those in its first drafts, whose uses almost never annoy, while GPT-6-sol’s revisions make no difference. GPT-5.6-sol’s revisions also add the construction, and GPT-6-sol’s remove some of it (Table 6 ). The annotators again seldom agree on which uses annoy (Table 9 ). A1’s arXiv 2026 rate is higher than in the pool, and A1 finds a few GPT-4o uses annoying , which A2 does not. One explanation is that A1 may be more affected by sensitization (Appendix S ) and so may have been more annoyed by the task itself by this point. Another explanation is that A1 discerns something else annoying about GPT-4o uses, compared with ACL 2019 uses, to which A2 is neutral.
blocks.zh: 在GPT比较集(表8)中,没有一位注释员发现ACL 2019使用烦人语,比如在游泳池. 来自GPT-6-溶胶纸的用法比arXiv 2026的用法更经常地使A2烦恼,而GPT-5.6-溶胶剂的用法也倾向于;A1发现没有比arXiv 2026的用法更烦恼. 由于许多ArXiv 2026文件可能是在大量LLM协助下撰写的(第3节),因此将肯定由LLM写的文本与可能至少部分写成的文本进行比较。 GPT-5.6-sol的修订问题:在订正文件中,它的使用比其初稿中的更经常地使两个注释者感到烦恼,因为其使用几乎从不令人烦恼,而GPT-6-sol的修订则毫无差别。 GPT-5.6-sol的修订也添加了构件,而GPT-6-sol删除了部分构件(表6. 注释者很少同意使用烦恼(表9)。 A1的arXiv 2026率比游泳池高, A1发现少数GPT-4o使用烦人语, A2没有使用. 一种解释是,A1可能受敏化的影响更大(Appendix S),因此从这一点上看,任务本身可能更加烦恼. 另一种解释是,A1识别出其他令人讨厌的GPT-4o用途,与ACL 2019用途相比,A2是中性的.

blocks.en: In the Claude comparison set (Table 11 ), A1 finds uses in Claude papers more annoying than ACL 2019 uses, but the increase comes from the revisions. Claude’s first drafts are indistinguishable from ACL 2019 uses and annoy A1 less often than the first drafts of GPT-6-sol, whose uses annoy from the start. Revision removes this advantage: Claude’s revised uses annoy A1 about as often as GPT-6-sol’s, and more often than Claude’s own first drafts, as for GPT-5.6-sol (Section 5.1 ) and unlike GPT-6-sol. Overall, the two families therefore do not differ, and the two Claude models behave alike. The first-draft difference is in the direction the stance results predict, but stance does not explain it: the stance of Claude’s revisions is as mild as that of its first drafts, and within this set it separates annoying uses from others only weakly, whichever of two raters is used (Appendix Q ), unlike in the pool (Section 5.3 ). Disavowal accounts for it: revised uses are more often disavowals (Table 18 ), disavowals annoy A1 far more than other uses (Table 17 ), and the higher rate in revisions largely disappears once disavowal is taken into account, whereas stance adds nothing (Table 12 ). The labels are A1’s alone, from a later session than the earlier sets, and A1’s rate for GPT-6-sol is higher here than in the GPT comparison set (Table 8 ), so the rates should be compared within this set, not across sets. That revised uses annoy more is not an effect of seeing the same text again (Appendix S ). The tests are uncorrected, with 50 to 90 uses per cell, and A2’s labels will show whether they hold.
blocks.zh: 在克洛德比较集(表11)中,A1发现克洛德论文中的用法比ACL 2019的用法更烦人,但增加来自修改. Claude的第一稿与ACL 2019的用法无法区分,与GPT-6-sol的第一稿相比,A1的用法较少而烦恼,后者的用法从一开始就很烦恼. 修订版取消了此优势 : Claude修改后的A1用法与GPT-6-sol一样频繁, 也比克勞德自己的初稿更频繁, 因此,总的来说,两个家庭没有不同,两个克洛德模式的行为相同。 第一稿的区别在于立场结果所预测的方向,但立场并没有解释:克劳德修订稿的立场和第一稿一样温和,在此套中,它只把烦人的用法与其他人的用法相去甚远,以两个评分者中使用者为准(附录Q),这与集合中的用法不同(第5.3节)。 其原因包括:修改后的用途更经常是取消(表18),取消A1比其他用途烦恼多得多(表17),而修改率越高,在考虑取消后就基本消失,而立场则无所作为(表12)。 标签单是A1的,从较前几套的较晚的会话开始,这里A1的GPT-6-sol的利率高于GPT的比较集(表8),因此应该在本套内,而不是跨套进行比较. 修改后的用法更令人恼火,不是再次看到同一文本(附录S.)的效果。 测试没有校正,每个单元格有50到90个用途,A2的标签会显示是否持有.

blocks.en: 5.3 What makes a use annoying
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 干嘛这么烦人?

blocks.en: Annoying uses seem to differ from legitimate ones mainly in how they treat the rejected alternative: it is presented less favorably, and coders other than the annotator more often judge it a straw man, although they agree poorly on which items are straw men. Syntactic and semantic features add weaker evidence, and several other factors show no association.
blocks.zh: 令人厌恶的用法似乎与合法用法不同,主要是如何对待被否决的用法:这种用法的提出不太有利,而除注释员外,其他编码员往往判断它是一个吸管员,尽管他们对哪些物品是吸管员的看法很差。 道能和语义特征增加了较弱的证据,另外几个因素表明没有关联.

blocks.en: If annoying uses tend to reject positions nobody holds, people other than the annotator should judge their rejected alternatives to be straw men more often than those of legitimate uses. They do, for the labels of both annotators (Table 13 ). A3 and A4 never judged annoyance, and each coder taken alone points the same way against the other people’s labels. However, the coders disagree widely on how many items are straw men, so a straw man, just like an annoying use, is partly in the eye of the beholder. 11 11 11 LLM coders agree with them no better (Appendix R ). The comparisons with A2’s labels rest on few items, since A2 labeled few test items annoying , and A2’s own codes, which mark few items as straw men, add little against A1’s labels. An annotator’s own straw-man codes match the same annotator’s labels far more closely, but we do not count this as evidence, since one person made both judgments.
blocks.zh: 如果令人烦恼的用途倾向于拒绝任何人担任的职位,除注释员之外,其他人应该判断自己被拒绝的替代方法比合法用途的人更经常成为稻草人。 两者的标签都是如此(表13)。 A3和A4从未判断过烦恼, 然而,编译者对于稻草人有多少物品存在广泛的分歧,因此一个稻草人,就像令人讨厌的用法一样,部分地在被摄取者的眼中. 11个11个LLM编译者同意他们的说法,没有更好的(附录R. 与A2标签的比较仅停留在少数物品上,因为A2标签上很少有令人讨厌的试验物品,而A2自己的编码则将很少物品标为稻草人,对A1的标签几乎没有增加. 一个书记员自己的稻草人代码与同一个书记员的标签相近得多,但我们不把这算作证据,因为一个人做出了两种判断。

blocks.en: We predicted that annoying uses present the affirmed alternative X more favorably, and the rejected alternative Y less favorably, than legitimate uses do, and that Y is presented less favorably in uses coded as straw men. Both predictions hold (Table 14 , All items ): for both annotators, annoying uses set X above Y by about two points on the five-point scale, legitimate uses by about one, and Y is rated lower in uses that A1, A2 and A4 code as straw men (A3’s codes go the same way without reaching significance). The pattern recurs in the GPT comparison set, for A1 and Either (Appendix O ). It also holds within each batch of the pool, and the gap is as large in A1’s first batch as in the second, so it does not come from A1’s growing sensitivity (Appendix K ).
blocks.zh: 我们预测,令人烦恼的用途比合法用途更有利于确认的X替代物,而被拒绝的Y替代物更不利于合法用途,而Y作为稻草人编码的用途则不那么有利于。 两种预测都持有(表14,所有项目):对于两个注释者来说,在Y上面的烦人用法在五分制尺度上比X大了大约两分,合法用法在1分左右,在A1、A2和A4编码的用法中,Y被评为低等(A3的用法相同,没有达到意义)。 在GPT比较集中,A1和One(附录O)的图案重复出现. A1的第一批和第二批一样大, 因此它并非来自A1的不断增强的敏感性(附录K)。

blocks.en: Part of the difference comes from uses that favor the rejected alternative ( inverted uses), whether they contrast the author’s approach with prior work or defend a limitation. About a fifth of legitimate uses are rated inverted, and few annoying ones: a use that grants the rejected alternative its value seldom annoys. With inverted uses left out, annoying uses still set X further above Y than legitimate uses do, for both annotators and Either , although the gap between the two groups is smaller (Table 14 , Non-inverted items ). The straw-man result, in contrast, disappears: most inverted uses were coded as not straw men, and among the remaining uses Y is not clearly lower in straw men. A blind human check confirms the direction of the ratings and shows that they treat some neutral contrasts as inverted, so the share of inverted uses is probably overstated (Appendix Q , Table 56 ).
blocks.zh: 部分区别来自赞成被否决的替代办法(倒置的用法)的用法,无论是将作者的方法与以前的工作相比较还是为某种限制辩护。 大约五分之一的合法用途被评为倒置,很少有令人烦恼的用途:这种用途赋予被拒绝的替代品的价值很少令人烦恼。 由于排除了倒置用途,对于注释者和Oui来说,令人烦恼的用途仍然比合法用途远在Y上方,尽管这两个组之间的差距较小(表14,非倒置项目)。 稻草人的结果则相反地消失了:大多数倒置用途被编码为不是稻草人,而其余用途中Y在稻草人中并不明显较低. 盲目的人类检查证实了收视率的方向,并显示他们将一些中性对比视为倒置,因此倒置用途的比例很可能被夸大了(Appendix Q,表56.

blocks.en: The disparaging contrast is more common where the construction is more common (Table 15 ). Random uses from arXiv 2026 papers present the rejected alternative negatively more often than uses from ACL 2019 papers, and uses from GPT papers more often still, most of all GPT-6-sol’s. The property that sets annoying uses apart thus becomes more common along with the construction itself.
blocks.zh: 在建筑较为常见的地方,贬低的对比更为常见(表15.). 2026年的ARXIV论文的随机使用比2019年的ACL论文的用途更常见地呈现出被否决的替代品,而GPT论文的用法更常见地仍然如此,其中最主要的是GPT-6-sol. 因此,将烦人用途分开的财产与建筑本身一起变得更加常见。

blocks.en: The Claude papers do not disparage the rejected alternative more than the source papers do (Table 16 ), unlike the GPT papers (Table 15 ), and their revisions disparage it slightly less. So a rate of the construction as high as the Claude models’ does not imply a stance as harsh as GPT-6-sol’s: the two properties come apart across model families. The Tülu 3 8B stages use the construction too rarely for a comparison, and the stage differences in the table, which point in no consistent direction, rest on a few uses each. The ratings are from one model, and all uses of a model are treated as independent although they come from the same papers. A milder stance should go with less annoyance, since annoying uses tend to disparage the rejected alternative (Table 14 ). The Claude comparison set tests this (Section 5.2 ): it holds for first drafts, but the stance does not explain the annoyance of Claude’s revisions, which disavowal does (same section).
blocks.zh: Claude的文件并没有比来源文件(表16)更贬低被否决的替代文件,与GPT文件(表15)不同,其修改略微贬低。 因此,与克洛德模型一样高的建造率并不意味着像GPT-6-sol那样严厉的立场:这两个地产在模范家庭之间相去甚远。 Tülu 3 8B相极罕见地使用构造来作比较,表中的相位差异指向不一致的方向,每个相位依赖于几个相位. 收视率来自一个模型,一个模型的所有用途都被视为独立,尽管它们来自同一篇论文. 较温和的姿态应减少烦恼,因为烦扰的用法往往会贬低被拒绝的替代品(表14)。 Claude的比较设定了这个标准(第5.2节):它为初稿提供了依据,但这一立场并不能解释Claude修改时的烦恼,而Claude的修改是否定的(同一节)。

blocks.en: Uses that disavow are far more often annoying (Table 17 ). For A1 the association holds in every set, including the two the category was not derived from. For A2 it holds in the GPT comparison set and has the same direction in the pool sample, where it is not significant, so the two annotators agree on the direction and differ in strength, as they do on which uses annoy. Disavowal is nearly unrelated to the stance gap (Appendix G ), so it is a separate property: a disavowal names as Y a claim the author declines, not an alternative the author disparages. Disavowals are absent from ACL 2019 uses and from GPT-4o’s, and common in LLM-written papers (Table 18 ); they are more frequent in revisions than in first drafts, both for Claude and for GPT-6-sol, which fits a model answering a review’s criticism of overclaiming by qualifying its claims, though the data do not test this.
blocks.zh: 弃权的用途往往更烦人(表17)。 就A1而言,协会在每一组中都持有,包括两个类别。 对于A2,它在GPT比较集中持有,在池样中具有相同的方向,在其中并不显著,因此两个注释者对方向一致,强度也不同,就像他们使用烦恼. Disavowal与姿态差距(Appendix G)几乎无关,因此它是一个独立的地产:因为Y是作者拒绝的,而不是作者拒绝的替代办法。 在ACL 2019的用途和GPT-4o的用途中都不存在否定,在LLM所写的论文(表18)中也很常见;对于克劳德和GPT-6-Sol来说,这种否定在修改中比初稿中更为频繁,这符合一个响应评论批评的模型,即通过对其索赔进行限定,尽管数据并没有检验这一点.

blocks.en: Few syntactic patterns go with annoyance after correction, and they differ between the annotators (Table 19 ). A1’s annoying uses more often open the sentence and more often have we as the subject of the main clause. A2’s more often contrast two adjectives ( implicit rather than explicit ) or two past participles, with Y parsed as a conjunct of X, and seldom have X as the object of a preposition. In Either , sentence-initial Rather than and an adjectival X survive correction. Sentence-initial Rather than goes with A1’s annoyance in both batches, the we subject only in the second, labeled after the first had been analyzed; A2’s patterns mostly reach p < .05 p<.05 in one batch, in the same direction in both (Appendix K ). In the GPT comparison set, with corpus controlled, the we subject again goes with A1’s annoyance, a past-participle and conjunct Y with A2’s, and an adjectival X with Either (Appendix O ).

blocks.en: Both annotators read arXiv 2026 passages as LLM-written far more often than ACL 2019 passages, and passages from the high-count papers most often (Table 21 ), which supports, in perception, the assumption that many arXiv 2026 papers were written with substantial LLM help. Annoyance, however, is not necessarily a reaction to perceived LLM authorship. A1’s annoyance is unrelated to whether a paper’s passages read as LLM-written, to A1 or to A2, while A2’s annoyance goes with the hunches of both annotators, as in the GPT comparison set, where GPT uses annoy A2 more often than arXiv 2026 uses and A1 about as often. The annotators also agree more on which passages read as LLM-written than on which uses annoy them (Table 9 ), so a shared perception of LLM style does not turn into shared annoyance (Appendix P ).
blocks.zh: 两位注释者都阅读了arXiv 2026的段落作为LLM-写作,远比ACL 2019的段落更频繁,以及来自高清论文最常被读取的段落(表21.),这些段落在观念上支持了许多arXiv 2026的论文是在大量LLM帮助下写作的假设. 然而,不满并不一定是对LLM著作权感的反应。 A1的烦恼与一纸的段落读作LLM-write,到A1或到A2无关,而A2的烦恼则与两个注释者的直觉相符合,如GPT比较集,GPT使用烦恼A2的频率比arXiv 2026的用法多,A1的频率也差不多. 注释者也更同意哪些段落读作LLM-写作,而不是使用这些段落的烦恼(表9),因此对LLM风格的共同看法不会变成共同的烦恼(Appendix P.

blocks.en: A3 and A5 confirm two of the three predictions (Table 22 ). Neither A3 nor A5 tells GPT passages from ACL 2019 passages better than chance, and neither does so when the GPT paper was written from an ACL 2019 paper, so the hunches do not detect LLM authorship as such (which was not the hypothesis). Both, however, read the construction itself as a sign of LLM writing: passages with it lean LLM more often than fillers from the same papers, in all three corpora. Their hunches relate to A1’s and A2’s annoyance weakly or not at all; the only significant association, A3’s hunches with the Either labels, is one of six tests. A3 and A5 also agree little with each other on which passages read as LLM-written.
blocks.zh: A3和A5证实了三个预测中的两个(表22.). A3和A5都没有将ACL 2019段落中GPT的段落比机会更好,在GBT论文由ACL 2019相纸所写时也不会这样,因此直觉没有检测出LLM的作者身份本身(这不是假说). 然而,两人都把构造本身读作LLM写作的标志:其中的段落比同一篇论文中的填充者更经常地将LLM倒在了三个公司里. 他们的直觉与A1和A2的烦恼有微弱的或根本没有的关联;唯一重要的关联,即A3的直觉与两个标签是六种测试之一. A3和A5对于哪些段落读作LLM-writment,彼此也很少认同.

People who choose between two responses thus reward rather than at least as much as LLM judges do. blocks.en: All four reward models prefer a sentence with its rather than Y clause to the same sentence without it (Table 24 ). Much of that preference is for more text in that slot: a non-contrastive clause of the same length earns most of the gain, and the gain grows with the length of the clause. The original sentence still beats the length-matched control for every model, and sentiment does not account for the difference: the three versions hardly differ in sentiment, and the difference survives holding the sentiment difference fixed. In ACL 2019 uses, the preference over the control is clear for only two of the four models. These reward models thus credit the clause beyond its length and tone. They need not credit antithesis as such, since one replacement clause per item cannot separate the contrastive form from the content of Y, and all four models come from one family. The clause gains more, with its length held fixed, in the uses A1 labeled annoying than in those A1 labeled legitimate, for three of the four models; the uses that annoy A2, whose clauses are shorter, show no such difference (Table 25 ). The reward models thus give the most credit to clauses that annoy at least one reader.

blocks.en: The evidence we have comes from models of 2023 (GPT-4, GPT-3.5-turbo, Bard, and open models such as Llama 2, Vicuna, WizardLM, Falcon and MPT), the prompts are general assistant tasks, and the effect on rather than is small. The experiment shows that an “honesty” instruction at inference time shifts models toward correction and disavowal; whether “honesty” as a training objective does the same, and whether it produces straw men in particular, remains to be tested.
